# Requirements Quality Checklist: System Audit Log

**Purpose**: Validate requirements completeness, clarity, and constitution compliance for the audit log spec — with cross-spec coverage against the RBAC integration contract.
**Created**: 2026-04-29
**Updated**: 2026-04-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Does FR-001 enumerate all mutating admin/moderator actions that must produce audit records, or does the phrase "every mutating administrative or moderation action" leave room for interpretation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001] — ✅ FR-001 now enumerates all actions explicitly
- [x] CHK002 Are the initial actions listed in FR-001 complete against the RBAC spec's permission set? [Completeness, Cross-Spec §005-FR-008] — ✅ Verified: covers all admin/moderator permissions from spec 005
- [x] CHK003 Are there requirements for audit-trailing `user.unban` specifically, or is it implied by the presence of `user.ban`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001] — ✅ `user.unban` explicitly listed in FR-001
- [x] CHK004 Is it specified whether regular-user actions should or should not produce audit records? [Gap, Scope Boundary] — ✅ Explicitly excluded in FR-001
- [x] CHK005 Are requirements defined for what happens when a new module adds an action not in the initial list? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009] — ✅ FR-009 open-string policy covers this
- [x] CHK006 Are the exact fields captured per audit record fully enumerated in FR-001? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001] — ✅ All fields enumerated

## Transaction Boundaries & Atomicity

- [x] CHK007 Is FR-002 explicit about bidirectional rollback (audit INSERT fails → business rolls back)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002] — ✅ FR-002 now states "unconditionally"
- [x] CHK008 Does the spec define behavior when the caller has no existing transaction? [Gap, Exception Flow] — ✅ FR-003 now requires the function to open its own transaction if none provided
- [x] CHK009 Are requirements defined for the maximum number of audit records a single transaction may produce? [Gap, Edge Case] — ⏭️ Deferred: bounded by practical limits, no explicit max needed
- [x] CHK010 Is FR-003 sufficient for call patterns outside request context? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003] — ⏭️ Deferred: background jobs are a future module concern

## Immutability & Integrity

- [x] CHK011 Does FR-008 account for super admin override, or is immutability absolute? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008] — ✅ FR-008 now states "no exceptions — including super admins"
- [x] CHK012 Are requirements defined for protecting against direct database access? [Gap, Coverage] — ⏭️ Deferred: DBA/infrastructure concern, not a spec requirement
- [x] CHK013 Is the immutability enforcement mechanism specified at a requirements level? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008] — ✅ FR-008 now specifies "trigger" (not "trigger or policy")
- [x] CHK014 Are requirements defined for what happens if the immutability trigger is accidentally dropped? [Gap, Resilience] — ✅ FR-008 requires migration comment documenting trigger purpose

## JSONB Schema & Data Design

- [x] CHK015 Are `previous_values` and `new_values` required to follow a consistent schema per entity type? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010] — ⏭️ Deferred: schema per entity type is an implementation detail
- [x] CHK016 Is the 10 KB per-field size limit elevated to a formal requirement? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010 vs Edge Cases] — ✅ Now formalized as FR-010a
- [x] CHK017 Are requirements defined for how to handle a value change where only a subset of fields changed? [Gap, Spec §FR-010] — ✅ FR-010 clarified: full snapshots, not diffs
- [x] CHK018 Is there a requirement for the JSON fields to be queryable? [Clarity, Coverage] — ⏭️ Deferred: queryability is an implementation optimization

## Query & Filtering

- [x] CHK019 Are the filter parameters in FR-04 individually testable with acceptance criteria? [Measurability, Spec §FR-004] — ✅ User Story 2 covers all filters
- [x] CHK020 Is the cursor format for keyset pagination defined? [Gap, Spec §FR-005] — ⏭️ Deferred: cursor format is an implementation detail per Constitution Art. VIII
- [x] CHK021 Are requirements defined for the maximum page size? [Gap, Edge Case] — ⏭️ Deferred: standard page size default is sufficient
- [x] CHK022 Is it specified whether the query endpoint returns audit records for all entity types or only those the querying admin has permissions for? [Clarity, Scope Boundary] — ⏭️ Deferred: all entity types returned (permission gates access, not entity type)

## RBAC Integration Contract

- [x] CHK023 Does the spec explicitly require adding `audit.read` to the predefined permissions seed data? [Consistency, Spec Assumptions vs §005-FR-008] — ✅ Now formalized as FR-016
- [x] CHK024 Are the role-to-permission mappings for `audit.read` defined for custom roles? [Completeness, Cross-Spec §005-FR-009] — ✅ FR-016 clarifies: custom roles only via explicit super admin assignment
- [x] CHK025 Is there a requirement for the audit query endpoint to log its own access (meta-auditing)? [Gap, Completeness] — ✅ Marked out of scope in Assumptions
- [x] CHK026 Does FR-007's requirement to gate access via `audit.read` align with the RBAC spec's middleware pattern? [Consistency, Cross-Spec §005-FR-006] — ✅ Aligned with spec 005 FR-006 pattern

## Constitution Compliance

- [x] CHK027 Does the spec comply with Article I (raw SQL, no ORM)? [Consistency, Constitution Art. I] — ✅ No abstraction layer implied
- [x] CHK028 Does the spec comply with Article II (migration-first)? [Coverage, Constitution Art. II] — ✅ Table, triggers, and indexes delivered via db-migrate
- [x] CHK029 Does the spec comply with Article IV (transaction safety)? [Consistency, Constitution Art. IV] — ✅ FR-002/FR-003 cover BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK patterns
- [x] CHK030 Does the spec comply with Article VII (max 3 tables per migration)? [Coverage, Constitution Art. VII] — ✅ Single table design
- [x] CHK031 Does the spec comply with Article VIII (no repository abstractions)? [Consistency, Constitution Art. VIII] — ✅ FR-003 aligns with pg Pool client pattern
- [x] CHK032 Does the spec comply with Article IX (backwards compatibility)? [Coverage, Constitution Art. IX] — ✅ New table only, no existing table modifications

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK033 Are alternate flow requirements defined for when the audit function is called with null/empty `previous_values` AND null `new_values`? [Coverage, Exception Flow] — ✅ FR-010 now requires at least one to be non-null
- [x] CHK034 Are recovery requirements defined for PII redaction in immutable records? [Gap, Recovery Flow] — ✅ Marked out of scope in Assumptions
- [x] CHK035 Are requirements defined for concurrent writes targeting the same entity? [Coverage, Concurrency] — ✅ Sequential ID + edge case already covers this
- [x] CHK036 Is the system actor ID given a specific value or range? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011] — ✅ FR-011 now specifies actor_id = 0 for system actors
